title: A query that runs past the end of the text hits unreachable!() in compare
body:
`SufrSearch::compare` in `libsufr/src/sufr_search.rs` decides the ordering from the next byte of the query and the next byte of the text:

```rust
match (query.get(full_offset), &self.get_text(suffix_pos + full_offset)) {
    (None, _) => Ordering::Equal,
    (Some(a), Some(b)) => a.cmp(b),
    _ => unreachable!(),
}
```

The last arm is reachable. Take a query that matches a suffix all the way to the end of the text and still has bytes left. An example is `T$A` against a text ending in `T$`. The LCP stops at the end of the text, `query.get` returns `Some` and `get_text` returns `None`, and the search panics. This requires the query to contain the sentinel byte, which no current check prevents.

The `Mask` branch of `compare` feeds the same match and may reach it the same way. That path has not been traced.

Found by reading the code. Not reproduced.
close_reason: Fixed in 0a209e8: the (Some, None) arm of compare answers Greater. T$A and ACGTNNACGT$A on fixture 1 find nothing instead of panicking; test_search pins both.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4be42394
notes.text: At cff9fb6 the site is `compare` (`search.rs:238-257`), with `unreachable!()` at :254. `sufr count data/inputs/1.sufr 'T$A'` panics there.

notes.author: Jeb Rosen/f3787cc2
notes.text: On dev this fix landed in 9984777 (PR #14): the (Some, None) arm of `compare` in `libsufr/src/sufr_search.rs` answers Greater. `test_query_past_the_sentinel` in `libsufr/src/sufr_file.rs` pins it.
